1.Name: Memoria - Primary Database (Local Cluster)
1.Comment: Master PostgreSQL 17 cluster hosting all Memoria microservice databases

2.Name: Memoria - Identity Service (identity_db)
2.Comment: Stores user accounts, passwords, sessions, and authentication credentials

3.Name: Memoria - Memory Service (memory_db)
3.Comment: Stores memory spaces, memory stories, tags, metadata, and profile links

4.Name: Memoria - Media Service (media_db)
4.Comment: Stores media assets, upload sessions, checksums, and image/video derivative paths

5.Name: Memoria - Collaboration Service (collab_db)
5.Comment: Stores family space memberships, invitations, permission roles, and comments

6.Name: Memoria - Book Studio Service (book_db)
6.Comment: Stores book drafts, page spreads, chapters, covers, and frozen digital editions

7.Name: Memoria - Commerce & Print Service (commerce_db)
7.Comment: Stores physical book orders, fulfillment states, and shipping addresses

8.Name: Memoria - Notification Service (notification_db)
8.Comment: Stores real-time in-app notifications, invites, and background job alerts
